lines.text: Sennacherib of Assyria captured Judah's fortified cities, then sent the Rabshakeh with a great army from Lachish to Jerusalem.
The Rabshakeh stopped by the aqueduct of the upper pool, and Eliakim, Shebna and Joah went out to him.
The Rabshakeh said Judah trusted in Babylon, a splintered reed of a staff that pierces the hand.
The officials asked for Aramaic, but he stood and called out loudly in Hebrew.
He named the gods of Hamath and Arpad, but the people stayed silent because Ahaz commanded it.
